bash.description: Run a bash command inside the isolated sandbox workspace. Use this for repository inspection/execution tasks that need shell access. Do not use for network-sensitive or destructive actions unless explicitly required.
bash.name: bash

createEventAutomation.description: Create a durable event automation in the active Slack channel or DM, never a thread. It executes the supplied instruction for every matching event. Use for whenever-this-happens-do-X automation; ordinary watch, notify, or tell-me-when requests use watchEvents instead. The automation may use the creator's connected credentials. Prefer a subscribable tool result when available.
createEventAutomation.name: createEventAutomation

publishImage.description: Publish one sandbox image to a durable public HTTPS URL. Anyone on the internet with the URL can view the image. Use only when an external destination needs a public image URL. Do not use for private file sharing or private conversation storage. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP up to 10 MB.
publishImage.name: publishImage

slackScheduleCreateAutomation.description: Create a one-time or recurring Junior task in the active Slack channel. Store the requested future work; do not perform it or check its service access now unless the user also asks for that.
slackScheduleCreateAutomation.name: slackScheduleCreateAutomation

slackScheduleUpdateAutomation.description: Update a scheduled automation. Set destination to "here" to move it to the active Slack channel.
slackScheduleUpdateAutomation.name: slackScheduleUpdateAutomation

updateEventAutomation.description: Update the instruction, registered trigger, credential use, or status of an event automation.
updateEventAutomation.name: updateEventAutomation

github_cloneRepository.description: Clone a GitHub repository into the sandbox as an ad-hoc checkout. The destination must not already exist. When matching Workspaces exist this is a tool input error: call switchWorkspace instead, or pass allowAdHoc=true for an intentional ad-hoc checkout.
github_cloneRepository.name: github_cloneRepository

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_createIssue.description: Create a GitHub issue with a runtime-owned conversation footer. Use this instead of shelling out to gh issue create when creating issues.
github_createIssue.name: github_createIssue

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_createPullRequest.description: Create a GitHub pull request with a runtime-owned conversation footer and assign it to the requester's linked GitHub account when available. Use this instead of shelling out to gh pr create when creating pull requests.
github_createPullRequest.name: github_createPullRequest

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_resolvePullRequestReviewThread.description: Resolve a GitHub pull request review thread after acting on its feedback. Only works on pull requests the bot authored.
github_resolvePullRequestReviewThread.name: github_resolvePullRequestReviewThread

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_updateIssue.description: Update an existing GitHub issue's title, body, or open/closed state. Use this instead of raw GitHub API calls when changing issue metadata.
github_updateIssue.name: github_updateIssue

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_updatePullRequest.description: Update an existing GitHub pull request's title, body, base branch, open/closed state, or draft state. Use this instead of raw GitHub API calls when changing PR metadata or marking a PR ready for review.
github_updatePullRequest.name: github_updatePullRequest

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

github_updatePullRequestFeedback.description: Set Junior's outcome reaction on GitHub pull request feedback: addressed (+1) or declined (-1). Use the commentId and commentKind from the event after acting on the feedback. Replaces only Junior's prior status reaction on that comment.
github_updatePullRequestFeedback.name: github_updatePullRequestFeedback

catalogSource.description: GitHub deployment, issue, pull request, release, and repository workflows via GitHub App

google_createCalendarEvent.description: Create a Google Calendar event organized by Junior's own Google account and email invites to the attendees. Every event gets a Google Meet link. Junior can later change or cancel it. Use after the requester confirms the time, or when they already gave an exact time. Check the time with findMeetingTimes first unless the requester says to book it anyway. Only people in the company's Google Workspace domains can be invited.
google_createCalendarEvent.name: google_createCalendarEvent

catalogSource.description: Google Calendar scheduling, Meet transcripts, and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides reading as Junior's own Google Workspace account

google_findMeetingTimes.description: Find meeting times when every required attendee is free and inside working hours in their own calendar time zone, using Google Calendar free/busy data from Junior's own Google account. Returns open slots only, never event details. Slots are spread across days and times; offer them as a short list. Only people in the company's Google Workspace domains can be checked. People in `unavailable` were not checked: say so instead of treating them as free. If no slot is free, widen the window or shorten the meeting once, then offer the closest option.
google_findMeetingTimes.name: google_findMeetingTimes

catalogSource.description: Google Calendar scheduling, Meet transcripts, and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides reading as Junior's own Google Workspace account

vercel_deploymentCreate.description: Start a deployment from a Vercel project's linked GitHub repository. Uses project build settings and environment credentials, so builds may run migrations. Returns the new deployment; inspect it to check readiness.
vercel_deploymentCreate.name: vercel_deploymentCreate

catalogSource.description: Deploy and inspect Vercel projects, manage aliases, query logs, and monitor outcomes

mcp__linear__save_comment.description: [linear] Create or update a comment on a Linear issue. If id is omitted, create a new comment on the supplied issueId.
mcp__linear__save_comment.name: mcp__linear__save_comment

mcp__linear__save_issue.description: [linear] Create or update a Linear issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing issue; otherwise creates a new one.
mcp__linear__save_issue.name: mcp__linear__save_issue
